name: telegram-zoom-assistant
description: Telegram-controlled Zoom attendance bot using official Zoom Meeting SDK

scripts.dev:api: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w apps/telegram-bot && tsx watch apps/api/src/index.ts
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w packages/shared -w packages/crypto -w packages/database -w packages/meeting-parser -w packages/queue -w packages/zoom -w packages/orchestrator
scripts.build:apps: npm run build -w apps/telegram-bot -w apps/api -w apps/scheduler -w apps/worker
scripts.build: npm run db:generate && npm run build:packages && npm run build:apps
scripts.test: tsx --test packages/meeting-parser/src/parser.test.ts packages/crypto/src/encryption.test.ts packages/zoom/src/capabilities/capability-resolver.test.ts packages/queue/src/locks.test.ts packages/queue/src/producers.test.ts apps/worker/src/state/state-machine.test.ts apps/worker/src/meeting-worker.test.ts apps/worker/src/worker-manager.test.ts apps/worker/src/monitoring/reconnect.test.ts apps/scheduler/src/recovery.test.ts apps/api/src/services/meeting-service.test.ts apps/telegram-bot/src/services/notification-service.test.ts
